request: Recheck the current paper against other papers and identify its actual novelty.

fresh_evidence.scope_limit: A bounded comparison of primary sources and indexed searches, not an exhaustive priority certification.
fresh_evidence.changes_after_previous_check: One commit adds APPT Lean formalizations; no projection-body source changes in that comparison.

comparison.source: Feng, Hu, Liu and Xu, On the Reverse Projection Inequality (2026), Theorem 1.3 and Section 4
comparison.already_established: The simplex maximum fails in every dimension n>=9, with at most n+2 facets; simplex-section and cube-projection construction tools.
comparison.our_distinct_claim: Specified rational seeds, stronger amplified rates and comparison against the complete point-generated product-join class.
comparison.do_not_claim: First counterexample, new threshold nine, or invention of the section method.

comparison.source: OpenAI, A product counterexample to the simplex maximum for projection-body volume (24 September 2026), Theorem 1 and Corollary 6
comparison.already_established: The exact dimension-twenty T_10 x T_10 counterexample, product multiplicativity and exponential excess over the simplex benchmark.
comparison.our_distinct_claim: An explicit family whose root limit exceeds the upper rate of every point-generated product-join tree, rather than only the simplex benchmark.
comparison.do_not_claim: First exponential improvement over simplices or new product multiplicativity.

comparison.source: Yongxian Zhang (mxym), Projection-volume calculus for joins and Cartesian products, version 2 (7 October 2026), Sections 2-5 and 9
comparison.already_established: Lifted invariant a, exact product-join state calculus, balanced binary recursion, tail enclosure and a certified root limit between 2.8534 and 2.8535.
comparison.our_distinct_claim: New geometric seed inputs and a certified rate between 2.9280 and 2.9283 using that inherited calculus.
comparison.do_not_claim: New recursion or operation identities. The fixed-dimension objective a R^3 is a direct consequence of the inherited recurrence and should be treated as a supporting optimization observation.

comparison.source: Yongxian Zhang (mxym), A positive sextic homogeneous Bellman envelope (7 October 2026 reader edition)
comparison.already_established: The manuscript states a whole-class upper rate below 2.85386, stronger than the older below-2.855 theorem used in our sealed release.
comparison.our_distinct_claim: The lower construction remains above this tighter ceiling, conditional on the external analytic upper theorem.
comparison.verification_limit: This audit inspected the primary statement and argument but did not independently replay or fully audit this newer sextic proof. The existing release's older pinned upper dependency remains unchanged.

comparison.source: Zhiqiang Xu, Multivariate Splines and Polytopes (2011), Section 3
comparison.already_established: Multivariate truncated-power and exponential-spline tools for polytope volume evaluation.
comparison.our_distinct_claim: Their application, with geometric facet weights and exact outward arithmetic, to certify the specified stronger seeds.
comparison.do_not_claim: Invention of spline inversion, multivariate interpolation, coarea or complementary-minor methods.

defensible_main_contributions_relative_t: An explicit rational eighteen-dimensional simplex-section seed with twenty-three genuine facets and amplified root limit strictly between 2.9280 and 2.9283.
A simpler symmetric fifteen-dimensional section with an amplified limit above 2.890, plus smaller two-upper-facet comparison seeds.
A strict exponential separation between unrestricted polytopes and the entire point-generated product-join class, using an attributed external upper theorem.
Finite rational operation recipes and a fixed-block extension beating that entire class in every dimension n>=9.
Exact reproducible certificates for these particular witnesses, their states and infinite-tail rate bounds.

review_assessment.mathematical_contribution: A substantive constructive and quantitative improvement relative to the inspected sources, supported by an entire-class separation theorem.
review_assessment.methodological_contribution: Primarily new seeds and careful synthesis/application of existing geometry and recurrence machinery; no established new general method.
review_assessment.interpretation: Richer starting geometry can exceed the best possible asymptotic rate obtainable from points by the same product-join operations.
